QuestInfo.name: Chrishrama in Need of Help
QuestInfo.0: The Arcforging master #p602# of #m10005000# seems to need help. Perhaps I should visit him again.
QuestInfo.1: The Arcforging master, #p602# of #m10005000#, received an important research request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. I'll need to defeat #r#o13#s#k and gather #b10 #t4000063##k to help him out.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to safely deliver the item requested by the Arcforging master #p602# of #m10005000#. Does this mean I can now be called his true apprentice?

0.0: Ah, you have arrived at just the right moment. I am developing a new scroll, yet I find myself lacking the materials needed for my research. Might you lend me your strength?

yes.0: My thanks. What I require are #b#t4000063##k pieces. It carries a mysterious power, though it is difficult to handle--so for research of this scale, I need quite a large amount. Please, make haste.

no.0: Hm... I had hoped you would understand why I devote myself so deeply to this research...

1.0: Excellent. With this much, I believe I can continue my studies for some time. Your aid has been invaluable.

yes.0: I cannot allow such effort to go unrewarded. Please, take this #t2002010#. With it, you may find the path of Arcforge training a little easier.
yes.1: Yet this is troubling... It seems far more #t4000063# pieces will be required for this study than I first predicted. I suspect I will be calling on your help again. Until then, travel safely.

mob.0: It appears you have not defeated all the monsters I mentioned. At this rate, I cannot complete my research.

item.0: It seems you have not gathered all the materials I asked for. At this rate, I cannot complete my research.
